item.tib: byams ma shes rab blo 'phel gyi dkyil chog rig pa'i sgo 'byed 'phrul gyi lde mig
item.coloph: zhes byams ma shes rab blo 'phel gyi dkyil chog rig pa'i lde mig ces bya ba 'di yang / shes rab kyi lha la bsgrub pa'i 'dun pa dang ldan pa'i/ khro skyabs rgya nag legs spel dpon po g.yung drung dge legs nyid kyis snga nas bskul ba dang*/ nye bar khro skyabs dge slong g.yung drung bstan dbang gis lha rdzas dri med kyi rten 'brel gyis mtshams sbyar te nye bar bskul ba la brten nas/ blo 'phel gyi sgrub thabs du ma snang yang / 'di las byin rlabs zab myur che ba mi 'dug pas rang blo gdeng khel yin stabs/ rje sman ri ba'i rjes 'jug phyi rabs rnams la phan re'i bsam pa dkar po'i kun nas bslang ste/ mnyam med rgyal ba gnyis pa'i gdan sa bkra shis sman ri'i bla brang rtse mor/ zhu gshen gyi bla ma 'ga' dang*/ rtogs ldan 'ga' re'i rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i lung gis zin khul du/ khyi la seng ge'i ming thob sgo btsun nyi ma'i ming gis/ chu byi rgyal zla'i tshes/ bde bar khrigs su bsgrigs pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/
